rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating (zone 406 -> about 360); strip rule for the car park: one tree per car-park island end
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's fifteen builder trees go (a front row along Eleventh alternating palms and broadleaf every 22 m, a row along the car park's island, some among the trash carts); six come back on their own spots: four of the front row (palm, palm, jacaranda, palm) and the two ends of the car park's island.

trees.why: the front grass along Eleventh by the agave and the box hedge: the row's west palm
the same front strip 38 m on: a queen palm
the front strip 22 m on: a jacaranda between the palms, the row alternating
the front strip 22 m on: a fan palm
the west end of the car park's island, by the wheel stops: the island-end tree
the east end of the same island: the other island-end tree
